- there is no record of what changed, or of wh"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"at it looked like before;
- and worst of all, **you cannot see what the finally assembled system pro"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"mpt actually looks like**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This plugin moves that into the Settings page: the assembly is laid out section by section, the part"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" you

Since g-084 a **read-only two-line status summary** sits under "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"that target line: the latest key node's assembly / delivery verdicts and "this layer: N override(s) "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"· M not in effect".
